items.title: US credit card debt hits record $1.29 trillion in third quarter
items.summary: Investing.com -- Credit card balances in the United States rose by $22 billion in the third quarter to reach a record $1.29 trillion, according to the Federal Reserve Bank of New York's household debt report released today. The balances increased 4.2% compared to the same period last year.

items.summary: Key TakeawaysFour of the five stocks Bill Ackman’s Pershing Square bought or added to in the second quarter are up since June 30: Mastercard, Visa, S&P Global and Meta Platforms. Netflix is down 11%.

items.title: Visa (V) Stock Could Be Reasonable With Excess Returns Intact
items.summary: Visa has delivered strong long term gains for shareholders, which puts a spotlight on whether the current share price is properly supported by the returns the business earns on its capital. With the stock now reflecting years of compounding performance and a growing role in global payments, the question is how much of those capital returns are already embedded in today’s valuation.
